title: fix(app-shell): the Studio header's More trigger keeps its own name (objectui#11794)
body:
Fixes #11794

Clause-②: no

The last slice of objectui#11794: item 1, which triage answered **B** (comment 6076172515). The maintainer's ruling on objectui#5813 item 3 stands, so *More* stays and *Access* stays inside it. What changes is the *More* trigger's label. It keeps the name *More* while one of its pillars is open, the same rule PR objectui#12028 applied to the Data pillar's *Advanced* trigger. Every other slice of the card has already landed or moved. Items 2, 3's search and 4 landed in PR objectui#12028, triage retired item 3's grouping, and item 5 moved to objectui#12035.

Implemented by the `os-dev` session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU` (claim comment 6076508917).

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the Studio header's *More* popover (`data-testid="studio-nav-more"`):

- **The trigger always reads *More*** (`engine.studio.more`). On `main`, while an overflow pillar was open, it read that pillar's own name (the `engine.studio.pillar.` key for the open tab, "Access"). That hid the word that says this control is the overflow menu.
- **The active styling stays.** As on `main`, the trigger keeps the open-pillar classes while one of its pillars is open.
- **The menu marks the open pillar as the current page.** Its router link carries `aria-current="page"`. This mirrors what PR objectui#12028 did inside the *Advanced* menu, where the open panel became the checked radio item. Here the items are router links that carry the pillar dirty-guard, not menu items, and `aria-current` is the semantic mark for a link to the open page. The visual mark, the active classes, was already there.
- The objectui#5813 docblock above the popover now describes the new behaviour.

Nothing else is mirrored. PR objectui#12028 did not add `aria-pressed` to *Advanced*, which already had it, so none is added to *More*. This PR adds no i18n key, no published prop, and no file outside the claim's surface.

## Hypotheses, measured

- **H1, the label switch is the only place the trigger takes a pillar's name: holds.** `git grep` for `studio-nav-more` and `engine.studio.more` finds one trigger and one call site. The file has three templated `engine.studio.pillar.` lookups. Only the trigger's ternary named the trigger; the other two label the pillar links themselves (the primary row and the menu item).
- **H2, no existing test pins the renamed label: holds.** No suite asserts the trigger's text. Two suites touch the trigger: `pillarNavGuard` clicks it, and `packageLessFlows-11553` asserts that it is absent. Both pass unchanged in the union below.
- **H3, `engine.studio.more` exists in every table the Studio serves: holds.** The engine `t()` (`pickTable` in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) serves `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` for a `zh` locale and `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` for every other locale. The key is in both ('More' and '更多'). It is not a `packages/i18n` key, and this PR adds none.
- **H4, first-load bytes stay the same: predicted here, measured by CI.** The console reaches this file only through the lazy `studioBuilder` chunk (`StudioRoute.tsx`, objectui#11798), so the eager closure should not move. The budget bot's reading on this PR is the measurement.

## Docs

`content/docs/guide/console.md`: no change. No page under `content/docs` describes the *More* menu, its trigger or its label, and neither does `packages/app-shell/README.md` or `apps/console/README.md` (checked with `git grep` for More, overflow and the testid). So no statement in the docs becomes false. The guide's *Object design* section, which describes the *Advanced* trigger's own-name rule, is unchanged.

## Evidence

All at HEAD `095712408`, with repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run` under the container's verify lock.

- **New pin:** `StudioDesignSurface.moreKeepsName-11794.test.tsx`, 3 tests, on the real surface and its real Radix popover.
  - With *Access* open, the trigger reads *More*, not *Access*, and carries the active classes.
  - Control: with a primary pillar (*Interfaces*) open, the trigger reads *More* and has no active classes, while the *Interfaces* link does have them. That shows the tokens are the active marker.
  - The menu marks the open pillar. With *Access* open, its link has `aria-current="page"` and the active classes; from *Interfaces*, it has neither.
- **Reverse leg**, run on the committed fix: `main`'s blob of the surface (`8a64971d`) was checked out over it, under a trap.
  - Result: 2 of 3 red (the label pin and the menu pin), and the primary-pillar control green, as expected.
  - Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`. The blob is back to HEAD's `6e61ec39`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Union:** every `StudioDesignSurface*` suite (73 files, enumerated with `git ls-tree HEAD`, the new pin included), plus `column-identity.ratchet` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273`.
  - Batch 1: `Test Files 37 passed (37)`, 175 tests.
  - Batch 2: `Test Files 38 passed (38)`, 329 tests.
  - All 23 suites that render the full surface (found by `git grep`) are in this set.
- **Gates:**
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, after building the dependency closure (turbo, `Tasks 28 successful`): exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin.
  - `pnpm exec eslint` on the two touched ts/tsx files: 2 files, 0 errors. There are 13 warnings, none in a changed hunk and none in the new pin.
  - Each exits 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no pillar or More key among the candidates), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check:unreferenced-sources`.

## Acceptance notes

- In the header row, the primary pillar links mark the open pillar only with the active classes, not with `aria-current`. Only the menu item carries it now. This is left alone because it is outside the claim and nothing is wrong when you use it. Carrier: none.
- The *More* trigger has no programmatic state that says one of its pillars is open. The *Advanced* trigger has `aria-pressed`, which predates PR objectui#12028. None is added here, per the mirror-only rule; a screen reader finds the open pillar inside the menu.
- Changeset: `.changeset/11794-more-trigger-name.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
